name: Bulwark of Darkness gives Pommel Smash 10% Dawn Blade damage per stack (#1199)
contract: Bulwark of Darkness 680496 has E1 aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER) MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), BasePoints 9 / DieSides 1 = +10, class mask (0, 0, 0x80000) in the installed server Spell.dbc (sha256 d3dd6072...), the record of Pommel Smash's aura 582588 (SpellFamilyFlags C 0x80000). Effect 1 of 582588 is aura 271 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER) BasePoints -1 / DieSides 1 = 0 with class mask (0x400, 0, 0) = Dawn Blade, and aura amounts are multiplied by the stack count, so each stack adds 10% Dawn Blade damage as the description says ('increased by $s2% for each stack'). E0 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1, mask C 0x10000) matches no family-21 record, so effect 0 (Magic damage taken, BasePoints 1 + 1 = 2) must stay at 2. Only the per-stack amount is asserted here; the cast-driven stacking is covered elsewhere and the older scenario reported-passive-modifiers.json expects 5 / 10 per one / two stacks, the value of an older Spell.dbc.

steps.label: Baseline effect 1 (damage from Dawn Blade) is 0 per stack
Baseline effect 0 (Magic damage taken) is the DBC's 1 + 1
The flat EFFECT2 modifier itself is +10 on Pommel Smash's aura
Dawn Blade is not touched by the EFFECT2 modifier
